method.method_draft: Use a graphical/vertex-enumeration linear programming route. Read the constraints as half-planes: x+y≤2, y≤x+2, x≥-1, y≥-1. Determine the feasible polygon vertices by intersecting boundary lines and checking feasibility: (-1,-1), (-1,1), (0,2), and (3,-1). Evaluate z=-4x+y at these vertices and choose the largest value. This computation gives the maximum at (-1,1), with value 5, so it would flag a discrepancy with the supplied standard answer 6.
